    Convex full subcategories and object deletion #

    If no morphism between surviving objects factors nontrivially through a deleted object, the deletion ideal vanishes on surviving Hom spaces. The canonical full functor from the surviving full subcategory to the deletion quotient is then an equivalence. Convexity for nonzero nonisomorphisms gives this factorization condition in a skeletal category.
